    """
    # Sentinel object to detect when one iterable is exhausted
    sentinel = object()
    
    # Convert all iterables to iterators
    iterators = [iter(it) for it in iterables]
    
    while True:
        items = []
        results = []  # Track (index, item_or_sentinel) for each iterator
        
        for i, it in enumerate(iterators):
            result = next(it, sentinel)
            results.append((i, result))
        
        # Check if any iterator was exhausted
        exhausted_indices = [i for i, (_, r) in enumerate(results) if r is sentinel]
        
        if exhausted_indices:
            # At least one iterator is exhausted

                # Some iterators are still alive - they're unequal!
                # Find the first exhausted and the last non-exhausted

                            f"zip_equal() argument {first_exhausted + 1} is shorter "
                            f"than argument {idx + 1}"
                        )

            # All iterators returned valid items
            for i, (_, item) in enumerate(results):
                items.append(item)
